title: My Little Violet Jazz
style:
Warm intimate jazz lullaby, soft breathy female vocal like a loving mother singing tenderly to her newborn baby girl, gentle upright bass, brushed drums, warm acoustic piano, subtle cymbal swells, very tender and soothing, includes gentle baby talk cooing and soft scat improvisation, lyrics about Jessica beholding her little Violet flower with deep love, foresight, modesty, faithfulness and protection, themes of the violet flower returning every spring, quiet virtue, sacred mother-daughter bond, soft dynamics, 70 BPM, emotional warmth and intimacy, perfect bedtime song, high quality vocal performance, cinematic yet simple jazz arrangement
[full lyrics above pasted here]
lyrics:
[whispered spoken]
Shhh… Jessica is here… beholding you…
My little Violet…

[Verse 1]
In the hush of the morning
So still and so deep
Jessica watches her Violet sleep
The name that means “behold” and foresight so true
Now looking at the flower… the vision is you

[Chorus]
Violet
My sweet little flower
Purple heart in the morning hour
Modest and faithful
You return with the spring
Loyal and loving
The joy that you bring
Jessica beholds you
Her eyes full of grace
God beholds you too… in this sacred space

[Bridge]
[half-sung
Cooing
Improvisational]
Ooooh… my wittle Vi-o-let
Coo coo coo… shhh my sweet pet
Doo-bee-doo… my flower so blue
[whisper] I see you… yes I do…
Bee-doo-bee… love’s melody
Just for my Violet… just for thee…

[Verse 2]
From Latin viola
The purple so fine
A symbol of virtue
Of love so divine
You grow low and humble
Yet reach for the light
In Jessica’s garden… you are the delight

[Chorus]
Violet
My sweet little flower
Purple heart in the morning hour
Modest and faithful
You return with the spring
Loyal and loving
The joy that you bring
Jessica beholds you
Her eyes full of grace
God beholds you too… in this sacred space
